description: The X1 Agent Registry in full: every registered agent, its owner and registration file, a live check of every endpoint it lists (MCP, A2A, x402 and the networks it accepts, web), whether it can be paid on X1, and feedback counts. The registry is new, so the list is short and says so. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: x1_agents
